Function Describe(f As Object) As String
Describe="range=" & f.AppliesTo.Address & ";formula=" & CStr(f.Formula1) & ";priority=" & CStr(f.Priority)
End Function
Function Capture() As String
Dim t As Workbook,f As Object,s As String
Set t=Workbooks.Open("C:\Users\William\.codex\worktrees\conditional-loaded\pyOpenVBA\tests\fixtures\conditional_loaded\generic-ordered-tail-permutation-51.xlsx",0,True)
s="props=" & CStr(t.FileFormat) & "|" & CStr(t.HasVBProject)
t.Worksheets("Data").Activate
Set f=t.Worksheets("Data").Cells.FormatConditions(1)
s=s & "||BEFORE||" & Describe(f)
f.ModifyAppliesToRange Union(t.Worksheets("Data").Range("M8:M9"),t.Worksheets("Data").Range("K3:K5"))
s=s & "||AFTER||" & Describe(f) & "||FRESH||" & Describe(t.Worksheets("Data").Cells.FormatConditions(1))
t.SaveAs "C:\Users\William\.codex\worktrees\conditional-loaded\pyOpenVBA\.cache\conditional-loaded-candidate\plain-modify-native-v2-samples\plain51.xlsm",52
s=s & "||AFTERSAVE||" & Describe(f) & "||FRESH||" & Describe(t.Worksheets("Data").Cells.FormatConditions(1))
t.Close False
Set t=Workbooks.Open("C:\Users\William\.codex\worktrees\conditional-loaded\pyOpenVBA\.cache\conditional-loaded-candidate\plain-modify-native-v2-samples\plain51.xlsm",0,True)
t.Worksheets("Data").Activate
Set f=t.Worksheets("Data").Cells.FormatConditions(1)
s=s & "||REOPEN||" & Describe(f)
t.Close False
Capture=s
End Function
